scale.helpful: answers the question correctly and usefully; minor style issues allowed
scale.partial: on topic but generic / incomplete / wrong language / noise / misattributed claims that do not change the decision
scale.bad: wrong refusal, answers a different question, or misleading claims that could change the user's decision

failure_codes.F1: false refusal: no fitting intent -> off_topic (static English text)
failure_codes.F2: no dialogue history: follow-up read as a standalone query
failure_codes.F3: intent/tool mismatch: answers a different question with the nearest tool
failure_codes.F4: wrong gameweek or chip state: GW7 asked, GW6 computed; used chips ignored
failure_codes.F5: verdict overturned or reasoning invented beyond FACTS
failure_codes.F6: past window presented as a forecast
failure_codes.F7: fixed table template forces computed or empty cells (x2 column, all n/a)
failure_codes.F8: language: English refusal / warning in a Russian chat, transliterated names
failure_codes.F9: citation misuse: [source] on FACTS claims, placeholder, 'https://fpl://'
failure_codes.F10: noise: club-news bullets, 'not covered by KB' framing, CLI hints
failure_codes.F11: player not in the game this season handled as 'won't play' / 'price not listed'
